comment: Vendor notices as the stream (shim, convert/notice-subject.ts) and the transcript (sidecar, internal/convert/notice_subject.go) read them. Each case is one notice: the vendor's declared error class (null when the record carries none) and its words, and the subject both planes must give it. The texts are the ones observed on the owner's host, read with their class and without it.
